Quick sync — what we know so far:
- I checked the quota-migration logs: an automated job (quota-migration-v3) executed at 07:55 PT and applied new tiering for several orgs. It appears a default project-level cap was set for some MediPoint projects and the org cap was reduced.
- That change would explain a sudden increase in 429s when traffic resumed after the early-morning lull.

Immediate actions I recommend:
1) Roll back the 07:55 tiering change for MediPoint projects (runbook: quota-rollback-steps.md).
2) Apply an emergency bypass (short-lived allowlist) so existing in-flight tokens are not rejected while rollback completes.
3) Offer short-term credits and pause any billing overage enforcement for impacted window.

I'm attaching the rollback runbook. Rishi — can SRE confirm whether the rollback is safe to run now and estimate time to completion?

-ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:45:19 -0700
Subject: Re: 429s started ~08:00 — production errors and timeouts

I executed the rollback at 08:39 PT (quota config reverted for all MediPoint projects). Initial observations:
- 429 rate down ~85% within two minutes after rollback (first confirmation at 08:41).
- We're still seeing concentrated retries from a subset of clients which is sustaining elevated error counts; client retries are amplifying transient failures.

What we did:
- Reverted project caps to pre-cutover values.
- Enabled temporary account-level soft-limit that returns 429 with Retry-After for clients to encourage backoff instead of immediate retries.
- Opened SUP-2331 to track remaining noisy callers and to throttle at edge for abusive retry patterns.

Next recommended steps (I can run these if leadership approves):
- Apply an emergency credit window (stop enforcement and set account to grace mode) to avoid billing surprises and reduce customer escalations.
- Push a tiny routing change to allow a fallback model variant for degraded requests (reduces service pressure).

Attachment: 429-metrics-08-41.csv (csv, 58KB) — snapshot of error rates and token throughput.

-Rishi
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
